name: geo-opt
description: Source-available AI-discoverability CLI: GEO content audit, Schema.org JSON-LD, technical SEO, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt — 100% local.

scripts.lint: eslint src/ bin/ scripts/ && python3 -m py_compile .agents/skills/geo-optimization/scripts/geo_optimizer.py .agents/skills/geo-optimization/scripts/test_optimizer.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && node scripts/check-test-count.js && npm run test:python && npm run test:conformance && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:schema && npm run changelog:check && npm run validate:package
scripts.validate:package: npm run build && npm run publint && npm run attw
scripts.prepare: node -e "const{cpSync,chmodSync,existsSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs');const{join}=require('path');const src='hooks/pre-commit';const dest='.git/hooks/pre-commit';try{const d=join('.git','hooks');if(!existsSync(d)){console.warn('[geo-opt] .git/hooks/ not found — skipping pre-commit hook install');process.exit(0);}cpSync(src,dest);chmodSync(dest,0o755)}catch(e){if(e.code==='ENOENT'){console.warn('[geo-opt] .git/hooks/ not found — skipping pre-commit hook install')}else{throw e}}"

author: Carlos Ortega González
